evidence: Cic. Off. 1.131: ōra, of twisting the face (Lewis & Short)
Ov. Ars 1.505: capillōs ferrō, to curl the hair (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: To turn or twist anything about: the neck, the eyes, a snake its coils, a spindle its thread; also, of the mind, to torment (torquet convīvam famē, Phaedr. 1.26).

evidence: Bell. Hisp. 38: tālum, to sprain the ankle (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: To twist into or round; also to wrench, sprain (see sprain), and to hurl a spear with a twist.

sources: Lewis & Short: torqueo · Lewis & Short: intorqueo
